name: aux_quantum_critic_v1
description: Auxiliary quantum-critic LoRA (NOT deployed standalone). Used as reward signal for Adapter A's RL stage, and as self-consistency selector at inference. Merges former N2 (critic) + N9 (selector) — same judge model, two uses.

usage_1_reward_signal.description: Replaces GLM5.2 teacher in Adapter A's RL grade step

usage_2_self_consistency_selector.description: At inference, run K candidates through the critic; argmax(pass) is the selected answer
usage_2_self_consistency_selector.inference_aggregation: argmax over critic.pass for k in candidates

stop_conditions: JSON parse error rate > 5% on eval split
reasoning field empty on > 10% of eval outputs
